article.title: Storing Paco (negative nominal interest rates)
article.excerpt: Paco is a dog who lives in Norman, Oklahoma. Recently I learned it costs $12 to store him for a day, with webcam services attached. In this sense there is a negative nominal interest rate on Paco. You might store Paco for a day if you are going to the Thunder-Clippers game , and you see leaving him at home as too risky.
